summary: The 2D screening label is illustrative_2d_only, and the Studio simulation did not run (status skipped). The gate failed because the custom experiment has no floorplan blocks and no power_w object, so Studio input validity fails (input_gate_pass=false, scientific_gate_pass=false, simulation_allowed=false). The selected scenario is the paper's 256-core SCC-inspired 2D processor in PACT versus HotSpot (PDF page 8, Section IV-A). It would be a custom 2D steady run, so there is no transient trace even though the paper also reports transient results. The paper reports only simulation-time speedups (up to 1.9x steady-state and 232x transient over HotSpot) and a hot-spot power density of 216.6 W/cm2. It gives no cited temperature observable with location and aggregation. Because no Studio result exists and no paper temperature is available, no numerical comparison is made and comparison_valid is false. Nothing here replicates the paper, exactly or approximately. The only defensible statement is qualitative: the scenario is 2D and steady-state relevant, and a 2D steady screening model could in principle show sensitivity to power density and heat-sink assumptions. Even that cannot be tested until a floorplan, per-block power and cooling parameters are supplied. The final verdict is no valid comparison and no validation of the paper's claims.
limitations: Studio did not run, so there is no simulated temperature or any other output to assess.
The custom experiment has an empty floorplan and no power_w. Block geometry and per-block watts are in image-only Table III/IV content that was not extracted, and total chip power is not stated.
The paper reports speedups (1.9x steady-state, 232x transient), not temperatures. No thermal observable with value, unit, location, or aggregation is cited, so no numerical comparison is possible.
The 216.6 W/cm2 hot-spot density has no stated location or area and cannot be converted to watts or assigned to blocks.

The original solver is a parallel SPICE-based compact RC network (Xyce, OpenMPI, KLU/AztecOO/TRAP) at grid resolutions in the unextracted Table III. Studio's solver and discretization would differ, and speed or accuracy results cannot transfer.
The HotSpot-style medium-cost heat spreader and heat sink parameters were not extracted. Studio's cooling stack and material assumptions are unknown, and these would change absolute temperatures.
The linked repositories (PACT, OpenSTA) are unpinned and their contents are unverified. The Eris et al. power profile (ref [20]) is not in the packet.
The evidence entries lack valid page or asset locators, and the adversarial code, parameters, config and data checks, plus the independent page/asset review, are unresolved.
The paper's transient results are not represented, because a custom 2D steady run has no transient trace, and the regime was not cited as steady or transient in the evidence.
No exact replication is claimed. The deterministic gate sets the final verdict as comparison_valid=false.
